clips.title: The story
paras: Drum Fel is an orc commander stationed at the Horde outpost of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Alongside his wife, Korin, he directs military efforts to secure the refuge against encroaching trolls, ogres, and human remnants. His strategic push is vital to carving out a lasting foothold for the Horde in Arathi.

Situated within the fortified refuge of Hammerfall, Drum Fel oversees the defense and territorial expansion of the Horde in Arathi. Surrounded by rival factions, he coordinates military strikes against the Witherbark forest trolls and the Boulderfist ogre clan holding Boulder'gor and Boulderfist Hall. Drum recognizes that Hammerfall cannot merely survive through isolation; it must break its neighbors' strength to thrive. To that end, he regularly directs veteran champions into hostile territory to disrupt regional threats before they can mount an assault on the Horde encampment.
